name: Idol Kyousei Sousa -Gaiden-
original_name: アイドル強制操作ー外伝ー
source:
Just one photo with a demon-enchanted smartphone
and he controls any of the beautiful girls he wants!

Star of the rhythmic gymnastics club, Runa Minatogawa
An H cup pinup girl, Asana Mamiya
A sassy magazine model, Azusa Mochida
A university student, Mitsu Kuroda

What fate awaits the girls under his control!?
